name: 26437-mtpprefill-80b-4gpu
hardware: 4x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one a3 node, one engine.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, EP off, one node, one in-process engine. The multi-token-prediction drafter runs inside that engine and inherits TP=4; there is no second engine.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=512, bounded at 512 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, no warmup and no cooldown -- the run is one wave of 512 requests admitted together.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, `request_format: plain` (raw completion string, no chat template). Prompt exactly 1024 tokens and output exactly 1024, greedy (`temperature: 0.0`), `ignore_eos` forced by `max_tokens` so every request emits exactly 1024 tokens. Generator seed 26437.
purpose: An 80-billion-parameter assistant with speculative drafting writing long passages for 512 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 4

# STRUCTURED VALUES -- keep each on ONE line. A reader that takes this file line by line skips
# indented lines, so re-flowing either into a block drops the key and the engine starts without
# it at rc=0.
speculative-config: {"method": "qwen3_next_mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 2}
# The engine's own default capture list tops out at 512, and a speculative step submits
# `num_seqs * (num_speculative_tokens + 1)` = up to 1536 tokens in one uniform-decode batch.
#
# 992 AND NOT THE SOURCE'S 2048, and the reason is this engine, not a preference. The source's
# serve line really is `--cuda-graph-sizes=2048`, so 2048 was faithful -- but at this commit
# FlashAttention refuses it. vllm/v1/attention/backends/flash_attn.py:239-245
#   if self.use_full_cuda_graph and self.aot_schedule:
#       if self.max_cudagraph_size > 992:
#           # This condition derives from FA3's internal heuristic.
#           raise ValueError("Capture size larger than 992 is not supported for full cuda graph.")
# and both conditions hold here: cudagraph_mode has full cudagraphs, and FA3 aot scheduling is on
# because this setup runs with VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=FLASH_ATTN (see the end of this file) --
# which is itself the source's own command line and so cannot be dropped either. Measured
# 2026-08-22: with 2048 every rank raises during engine construction and the run serves nothing
# (130 occurrences in one attempt, engine re-created and failed in a loop).
#
# 992 is the largest value this engine accepts, so it keeps full CUDA graphs on -- which is the
# property the source's flag was buying -- rather than turning them off.
cuda-graph-sizes: [992]

enable-prefix-caching: false

# Pinned rather than inherited: the defaults are decided by the usage context, and an engine
# constructed in-process rather than by `vllm serve` gets neither, falling back to max_num_seqs
# 128 -- an eighth of the declared concurrency.
max-num-seqs: 512
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-model-len: 4096
dtype: bfloat16

# ONE SETTING CANNOT LIVE HERE: this setup wants `VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=FLASH_ATTN`, and vLLM
# exposes that only as an environment variable.
